epic.title: EPIC-053: Natural Answer Display in the Question Panel
epic.functionalNeed:
With Natural Answer Parsing (EPIC-027, GEO-678), engines answer the way they would for a real user and the ranking, the competitive outcome, the perception themes and the sources are extracted from that answer afterwards. The stored answer becomes full prose: several paragraphs, lists, inline citation markers, and lengths that vary a lot between engines (24 words for Claude against 442 for ChatGPT in the design examples).

The question panel was built for a short, predictable answer. Today it shows only the text the engine wrote about the brand (Visibility and Competitive) or the extracted answer text (Perception), with the citation tags stripped. It does not hold a full answer.

[CHANGED 27 OCT] This epic owns the display only. The goal is that the user reads the full answer an engine gave and can check every extracted result against it. Competitive answers move from Won / Lost to four outcomes (Chosen, Conditional, Not chosen, Overlooked, defined in GEO-678), so the AI Choice card, the questions table and the question panel change with them. GEO-678 owns the parsing and stays parsing only. GEO-678 blocks this epic: the panel reads its output (outcomes, brand family, Not counted), so any change to that output during the build is reflected here before either ships. The design is GEO-1017 (Figma: Measure - GEO Module, page "Natural answer display").

The architect will go into the implementation details.

---

### Host Shells

The question panel opens from the questions table of a category view. Today it opens inline next to the table, which shrinks to make room. With this epic it becomes a full-height drawer over the page and over the host top bar, as drawn in GEO-1017 (frame 09, and the Unified Platform frame of the second round). It renders the same in both shells, and it opens only when the user clicks a row: no question opens by itself any more (the first-question auto-open of GEO-315 and GEO-345 is removed).

| Shell | How it is selected | Chrome it mounts | Chrome it does NOT mount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unified Platform, standalone | Onclusive Social native mode off | GEO sidebar, GEO top bar, organisation control, user menu | - |
| Inside Onclusive Social | Onclusive Social native mode on | Onclusive Social top bar only | GEO sidebar, GEO top bar |

- Nothing in this epic needs the settings entry or the organisation control.
- [CHANGED 27 OCT] Inside Onclusive Social, the drawer and the citation mini card follow the Onclusive Social frame of GEO-1017 and behave like the target sources drawer (native dialog, focus trap, arrow keys to the previous or next question), with the same 470px width in both shells.
- The sticky panel header (story 1.2) sits at the top of the drawer, which covers the host top bar in both shells, as in frame 09.

---

### Surfaces and States

Surfaces in scope: the question panel on screen, the AI Choice KPI card, the competitive rows of the questions table, the AI Choice column of Brand Rankings, the name of the metric wherever it appears (prioritization matrices, trend graph, upsell results, PowerPoint and PDF), and the Raw Data sheet of the Excel export.

No change: scheduled emails, and the PowerPoint and PDF ring, which keeps one colour (only the metric name changes there).

States

| State | Answer card | Extracted blocks |
|---|---|---|
| Loading | Skeleton of frame 04e | Skeleton of frame 04e |
| Engine added after the last run | "Analysis pending", as today | Not shown |
| Panel failed to load | Error with Retry, as today | Not shown |
| Full answer, longer than the clamp | Clamped at about 8 lines, "Show full answer" | Rendered |
| Full answer, shorter than the clamp | Shown in full, no control | Rendered |
| One extraction failed | Shown in full | The failed block keeps its title and shows one amber italic line instead of its content |
| Analysis run before this epic shipped | [CHANGED 27 OCT] The tracked brand's excerpt, as today (no full answer is stored for those dates) | Rendered as today, a competitive win shows Chosen and a loss Not chosen |
| Answer that names no brand (Visibility) | Shown in full | Verdict "No brands named", no ranking rows |
| Answer with no inline citations | Shown in full, "no inline citations" in the header | Rendered |
| Answer not counted (cut, refused, empty) | "{engine} returned no answer for this run" | Not shown, engine pill marked "Not counted" |

In the Excel Raw Data sheet, an analysis run before this epic shipped keeps the existing content of the "Response" column, and its "Ranking" column is filled from the stored ranking. The EPIC text is the Excel spec, there is no frame.

| Label | Produced by |

| "Source {n} of {total}" | The citation number of the marker and the number of sources cited in the text |
| Brand highlight in the answer | The brand mentions that GEO-678 finds in the answer |

technicalNotes.heading: Implementation summary (review, 2026-11-04)
technicalNotes.text:
Backend: `AnswerComposer` second overload (citation part) — validates and groups citation ranges (`UrlNormalizer.canonicalize`), renumbers 1..n in order of first citation, unions with stored `response_sources`, filters excluded domains (shared matcher with `ResponseSourceExtractor` via `DomainNormalizer.parseExcludedCsv`), shifts carried mentions, keeps a non-domain link's label as text with `[n]` appended right after it. Runs only when a `FULL` row's `reader_version` is set and `sourcesState = OK`; otherwise the 53.1 no-citation overload is used unchanged. `AnswerDto`/`SourceDto` gained additive `citations`/`citationCount`/`number` fields; new `CitationDto`.

Frontend: `remarkAnswerDecorations.ts` (remark plugin, hand-rolled mdast walker — no new dependency), `CitationMarker` (controlled `Tooltip` mini card, hover/focus/click/Escape per AC3/AC7), `CitationContext` (shared with the sibling `SourcesSection`, reset on engine switch), numbered opt-in mode on `SourcesSection`/`SourcesModal`/`SourceItem` (chip, dash for uncited, divider before uncited rows, scroll-to-row). i18n in all 4 locales (French/Spanish at the spec's own proposed texts, PM confirmation pending).

Tests: backend `AnswerComposerTest` (16, TAC1-TAC7 + T-E) + 2 new `QuestionDetailServiceTest` cases; frontend `remarkAnswerDecorations.test.ts` (6, incl. TAC13 and T-B), `CitationMarker.test.tsx` (6, TAC10/TAC11), `Sources.test.tsx` (+7, incl. TAC12), `AnswerMarkdown.test.tsx` (+2). Full regression: backend 3621/3621; frontend 3030/3032 (2 confirmed pre-existing unrelated flaky tests: `ReportListView` TAC5, `AddCategoryDialog` — both pass in isolation, neither touched by this branch); `pnpm build` green.

Open items flagged, implemented at the spec's own proposed defaults (not yet confirmed): P1 (FR/ES copy), P2 (AC5 "two numbers per row", non-blocking), D1-D4 (design). Not done this session: TAC14 (staging p95 timing) and the browser check on staging in both shells with real citations.

technicalNotes.heading: What we measured on 2026-11-12 (the three engines captured through the vendor)
technicalNotes.text:
Method: the same prompt, "What are the best running shoes for flat feet?" (country US), asked (1) in a real browser, signed in (Gemini Pro on the work account, ChatGPT Free, Google Search with its AI Overview), then (2) to the capture vendor (Cloro) with the default request. Extra vendor calls: ChatGPT with `include.shopping`, Gemini with `include.rawResponse`. About 8 billed calls in all, plus the earlier AI Overview sample (165 prompts) and recordings.

| Engine | What the real page shows | What the vendor returns |
|---|---|---|
| **Google AI Overviews** | Bulleted text; to its right, source cards with a thumbnail (RunRepeat, Shoe Station) and a YouTube video. No image inside the text for this question. | `aioverview`: `text`, `markdown`, `sources` (no thumbnail), `citationPills`, `videos`. **No image field**, in the 159 captured AI Overviews or in the recordings. A page-level `inlineImages` block exists on pages without an AI Overview (3 images in one case), with no position in any answer. |
| **ChatGPT** | A product thumbnail beside each model (Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25, ASICS Gel-Kayano 33, New Balance Fresh Foam X 860 v15, ...), with tags such as "Best overall". | Default request: text only (also on two prompts that asked for pictures). **With **`include.shopping` (paid add-on): `inlineProducts`, 7 products, each with 1 image (`image_urls`, hosted on `images.openai.com`), plus `title`, `description`, `price`, `featured_tag`, `position`; `shoppingCards` was empty. No marker of the product in the text, only the product's `position` in the list. |
| **Gemini** | A carousel of product images (Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25, ASICS Gel-Kayano 33, Saucony Hurricane 26, ...), each with a caption "Source: ...". | Default request: `text`, `sources`, `citationPills` only. No `shoppingCards`, no `places`, on this prompt and on a places prompt ("best coffee shops near the Eiffel Tower"). With `include.rawResponse` (562,000 characters): 11 image-looking URLs, which are Google thumbnails of the source pages (`encrypted-tbn*.gstatic.com`), and the shoe names, but **not the carousel images**. |

What the vendor's documentation says (docs for the ChatGPT and Gemini endpoints): ChatGPT images are product images only, in `shoppingCards[].products[].image_urls`, `inlineProducts[].product.image_urls` and `entities[].product.image_urls`, and come only with `include.shopping`; Gemini lists `places[].thumbnail`, `shoppingCards[].thumbnail` and `shoppingCards[].images` with no paid option, but we did not get them. The AI Overview endpoint documents no image field.

What this means:

- The only images we can obtain today are ChatGPT **product** images, behind a paid option. They exist on product-type questions only, not on reputation or perception prompts.
- For Gemini the image shows in the real page and the vendor does not return it: a limit of what the vendor extracts, or a difference of session (a signed-in Pro account against the vendor's anonymous one). We cannot tell which with two prompts.
- For AI Overviews there is nothing to show in the answer; the only images are source thumbnails and videos, which the vendor does not return as images.
- None of the images has a position in the text, a caption or a credit as drawn in frames 08a and 08b (only a title, a price and a tag for a ChatGPT product).
- The image URLs are hosted by the engines (`images.openai.com`, Google), see the security point below.

Limits of the measurement: one product prompt compared in the browser, one signed-in account per engine, a handful of vendor calls. Not measured: the engines' API route (OpenRouter), and the engines that are not captured (Claude and Grok are account-gated and never captured, Perplexity is not reachable).

Questions to put to the vendor: (1) are AI Overview images extracted, and in which field and with which option? (2) when are `shoppingCards` and `places` filled for Gemini? (3) is there an option, other than `include.shopping`, that returns the images of ChatGPT's informative answers? Questions for the PM: is a block of product images acceptable instead of images in the text, and is the cost of the ChatGPT `shopping` option (billed on every capture) acceptable?

technicalNotes.heading: What is known today (to verify when the story starts)
technicalNotes.text:
- The PM measured images in 28 of 30 ChatGPT answers of the GEO-678 Cloro dataset (not re-checked here: our default requests returned none, the measurements above explain when they appear); 0 of 24 AI Overviews measured in the 54.x spike had one inside the answer.
- The answer renderer (`AnswerMarkdown`) ignores images on purpose today; the application has no image viewer; the cleaned capture record keeps no image field (the raw capture may hold them).
- The thumbnails of captured images can be hosted by another site (Google or the engine's), and the application sets no image content-security rule today: showing them is a hosting and security decision for the team to take in this story.
- Frames 08a and 08b of GEO-1017 are cited by the epic but have no recorded node id in the repository.
